Notes.Name: PowerShell Timer with Alarm
Notes.Details: Simply call the function with the number of seconds and the optional alarm switch. It will provide a countdown with a progress bar.

Notes.Name: Make Your Computer Talk
Notes.Snippet:
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$Speech = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
$Speech.Speak("I'm sorry Dave, I'm afraid I can't do that")
Notes.Details: Use the built-in Speech Synthesizer to have PowerShell make your computer talk. Credit to u/urabusPenguin on r/PowerShell for the idea.
